agent_prompt_mixed_group: M'Buku langa la ndalama "{book}", gulu la {group} limaphatikiza ndalama zotsala (Katundu, Ngongole) ndi zochitika (Zolowa, Zotuluka). Ndithandizeni kuzilekanitsa m'magulu awo. Sinthani magulu okha, osati kusamutsa.
agent_prompt_no_net_result: Buku langa la ndalama "{book}" lilibe zotsatira zonse: palibe gulu lophatikiza {incoming} ndi {outgoing}. Ndithandizeni kukonza magulu ake kuti ndalama zolowa ndi zotuluka zikumane m'gulu limodzi. Sinthani magulu okha, osati kusamutsa.
agent_prompt_no_net_result_general: Buku langa la ndalama "{book}" lilibe zotsatira zonse: palibe gulu lophatikiza ndalama zake zolowa ndi zotuluka. Ndithandizeni kukonza magulu ake kuti ndalama zolowa ndi zotuluka zikumane m'gulu limodzi. Sinthani magulu okha, osati kusamutsa.
agent_prompt_no_net_result_shared: Buku langa la ndalama "{book}" lilibe zotsatira zonse: magulu ake {shared} amagawana maakaunti. Ndithandizeni kukonza magulu ake kuti ndalama zolowa ndi zotuluka zikumane m'gulu limodzi. Sinthani magulu okha, osati kusamutsa.
agent_prompt_nothing_to_report: Buku langa la ndalama "{book}" lilibe choti munene mu lipoti: {count} mwa maakaunti ake {total} omwe ali ndi kusamutsa sali m'gulu lililonse. Ndithandizeni kuwakonza m'magulu a malipoti, monga balance sheet ndi income statement. Sinthani magulu okha, osati kusamutsa.
book_picker_empty: Inu mulibe Mabuku a ndalama panobe.
